integrity: Exact algebraic proof and self-contained deterministic supplementary checker; finite numerical evidence is not substituted for the universal proof; historical novelty carries stated residual risk.
scientific_limitations: Robust real positive spectral interval, symmetric positive-definite linear generator, fixed unstable first Euler step and exactly one freely chosen positive correction; no floating-point, nonlinear or nonnormal assertion.
title: A fixed-step rescue frontier for an isolated stiff spectral band
